INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dict_values (kind, name) SELECT 'tag', name FROM tags WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name) != ''

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dict_values (kind, name) SELECT 'occasion', TRIM(x.name) FROM ( SELECT l.occasion AS name FROM lots l WHERE l.occasion IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.occasion) != '' AND instr(l.occasion, ',') = 0 UNION SELECT TRIM(substr(l.occasion, 1, instr(l.occasion || ',', ',') - 1)) FROM lots l WHERE instr(l.occasion, ',') > 0 UNION SELECT TRIM(substr(l.occasion, instr(l.occasion, ',') + 1)) FROM lots l WHERE instr(l.occasion, ',') > 0 ) x WHERE TRIM(x.name) != ''

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dict_values (kind, name) SELECT 'fabric', TRIM(x.name) FROM ( SELECT l.fabric_notes AS name FROM lots l WHERE l.fabric_notes IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.fabric_notes) != '' AND instr(l.fabric_notes, ',') = 0 UNION SELECT TRIM(substr(l.fabric_notes, 1, instr(l.fabric_notes || ',', ',') - 1)) FROM lots l WHERE instr(l.fabric_notes, ',') > 0 UNION SELECT TRIM(substr(l.fabric_notes, instr(l.fabric_notes, ',') + 1)) FROM lots l WHERE instr(l.fabric_notes, ',') > 0 ) x WHERE TRIM(x.name) != ''
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lot_dict (lot_id, dict_id) SELECT lt.lot_id, d.id FROM lot_tags lt JOIN tags t ON t.id = lt.tag_id JOIN dict_values d ON d.kind = 'tag' AND d.name = t.name

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lot_dict (lot_id, dict_id) SELECT l.id, d.id FROM lots l JOIN dict_values d ON d.kind = 'occasion' WHERE l.occasion IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.occasion) != '' AND (d.name = TRIM(l.occasion) OR d.name = TRIM(substr(l.occasion, 1, instr(l.occasion || ',', ',') - 1)) OR d.name = TRIM(substr(l.occasion, instr(l.occasion, ',') + 1)))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lot_dict (lot_id, dict_id) SELECT l.id, d.id FROM lots l JOIN dict_values d ON d.kind = 'fabric' WHERE l.fabric_notes IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.fabric_notes) != '' AND (d.name = TRIM(l.fabric_notes) OR d.name = TRIM(substr(l.fabric_notes, 1, instr(l.fabric_notes || ',', ',') - 1)) OR d.name = TRIM(substr(l.fabric_notes, instr(l.fabric_notes, ',') + 1)))
